title: Yacht Charter & Management Platform
tagline: Leading the team and architecture of a charter and fleet-management product
summary: A platform for chartering yachts and managing a fleet. I led the team and owned the architecture: turning the client’s business requirements into tasks, designing the database structure and reviewing the team’s code.
overview: A yacht charter and management platform for a US client, built with Next.js, FastAPI and PostgreSQL, covering bookings for charter customers and the operational side of managing a fleet.

I joined as team leader and senior architect. I ran the business discussions with the client, broke the requirements into tasks with the developers, designed the database structure, and reviewed code to keep the implementation consistent with the architecture.

points: Owned the technical architecture of the platform.
Designed the database structure for charters, fleet and management workflows.
Designed the access model: passkey sign-in and a custom role-based access control system.
Led business discussions with the client and translated them into technical requirements.
Planned and discussed tasks with the developers and tracked delivery.
Reviewed code across the team and guided implementation.
Worked from Figma designs, and used Claude for code help and technical discussion.

achievements: Led the team as architect from requirements through database design to code review.
